= PlaneGCS vendoring provenance

This directory (`kstep-constraints/src/main/cpp/third_party/planegcs/`) vendors an unmodified copy
of the PlaneGCS 2D geometric constraint solver, as maintained by the Salusoft89 WASM-bindings fork
of the code originally developed inside FreeCAD's Sketcher workbench. See
`docs/adr/ADR-0006-planegcs-constraint-bridge.adoc` for the full rationale, the vendoring decision,
and the license analysis this file's "License" section summarizes.

== Upstream source

* Repository: https://github.com/Salusoft89/planegcs
* Commit pinned: `ee9b156da9827a91a56a888a53520f63d5cffaa6`
* Commit date: 2026-07-06T16:56:38+10:00
* Tag at that commit: `1.2.0`
* FreeCAD upstream commit this fork was patched from (per the upstream repo's own
  `planegcs/commit.txt`): `5f8eac49f31626354ee69bf40616bac801ca5560`

== What was copied, and how

Every file below was copied byte-for-byte from the upstream repository at the commit above -- no
patch, no reformatting, no whitespace change. All original license headers are intact.

[cols="1,1"]
|===
|Upstream path |Vendored as

|`planegcs/GCS.cpp`, `planegcs/GCS.h`
|`GCS.cpp`, `GCS.h`

|`planegcs/Geo.cpp`, `planegcs/Geo.h`
|`Geo.cpp`, `Geo.h`

|`planegcs/Constraints.cpp`, `planegcs/Constraints.h`
|`Constraints.cpp`, `Constraints.h`

|`planegcs/SubSystem.cpp`, `planegcs/SubSystem.h`
|`SubSystem.cpp`, `SubSystem.h`

|`planegcs/qp_eq.cpp`, `planegcs/qp_eq.h`
|`qp_eq.cpp`, `qp_eq.h`

|`planegcs/Util.h`
|`Util.h`

|`planegcs/headers/FCConfig.h`
|`headers/FCConfig.h`

|`planegcs/headers/FCGlobal.h` (pulled in transitively by `FCConfig.h:267`'s
`#include <FCGlobal.h>`, even though no vendored `.cpp` includes it directly -- omitting it breaks
the build with `fatal error: FCGlobal.h: No such file or directory`)
|`headers/FCGlobal.h`

|`planegcs/headers/boost_graph_adjacency_list.hpp`
|`headers/boost_graph_adjacency_list.hpp`

|`planegcs/LICENSE` (LGPL-2.1 full text, the repo-wide license file)
|`LICENSE`
|===

`planegcs/headers/Console.h` was **deliberately NOT copied**: the upstream version is
Emscripten-only (`#include <emscripten.h>`, `EM_JS`) and cannot compile natively. The native build
instead uses a kSTEP-authored replacement at `kstep-constraints/src/main/cpp/Console.h` (Apache-2.0,
kSTEP's own copyright) -- see that file's own header comment, and
`docs/adr/ADR-0006-planegcs-constraint-bridge.adoc`'s Security section, for why it is written the
way it is (never treats its argument as a `printf`-style format string).

`planegcs/CMakeLists.txt`, `planegcs/update_freecad.sh`, `planegcs/patch_file.ts`, and every file
outside `planegcs/` in the upstream repository (WASM bindings, TypeScript sketch/test code, docs)
were **not** vendored -- kSTEP compiles the five vendored `.cpp` files directly with a single `g++`
invocation (see `kstep-constraints/build.gradle.kts`), not via CMake, and has no use for the
WASM-binding or TypeScript-test layers.

Reproduce with (from this directory):

[source,bash]
----
sha256sum Constraints.cpp Constraints.h GCS.cpp GCS.h Geo.cpp Geo.h SubSystem.cpp SubSystem.h \
  Util.h qp_eq.cpp qp_eq.h headers/FCConfig.h headers/FCGlobal.h \
  headers/boost_graph_adjacency_list.hpp LICENSE
----

Or re-clone the upstream repository and diff directly:

[source,bash]
----
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/Salusoft89/planegcs.git /tmp/planegcs-verify
cd /tmp/planegcs-verify && git fetch --depth 1 origin ee9b156da9827a91a56a888a53520f63d5cffaa6 \
  && git checkout ee9b156da9827a91a56a888a53520f63d5cffaa6
diff planegcs/GCS.cpp <kstep-repo>/kstep-constraints/src/main/cpp/third_party/planegcs/GCS.cpp
# ... repeat per file; every diff must be empty.
----

== License

Every vendored file's own header states: _"GNU Library General Public License ... version 2 of the
License, or (at your option) any later version"_ -- "Library GPL v2" is the historical name of what
is now called LGPL-2.0. This is confirmed by the upstream repository's own `package.json`, which
declares `"license": "LGPL-2.0-or-later"` (not a typo). The repo-wide `LICENSE` file vendored above
is nonetheless the LGPL-2.1 full text (the license of the Salusoft89 *wrapper* code -- CMakeLists,
WASM bindings, `update_freecad.sh` -- which is NOT vendored here); the solver files themselves are
LGPL-2.0-or-later, which "or later" makes usable under LGPL-2.1 or LGPL-3.0 terms as well. See
`docs/adr/ADR-0006-planegcs-constraint-bridge.adoc`, "Source and license", for the full analysis and
the practical (none) consequence of this correction.

Šerý, Salusoft89 (WASM packaging and the patches applied on top of the FreeCAD original -- see
`update_freecad.sh` in the upstream repo, not vendored here, for what those patches are).
